about: A support call to Marginalia about order M-1042, written for the course. Caio answers for the shop and Bia is the customer; neither exists. Each turn is spoken by one Piper voice and the gap after it is silence.

turns.text: Good morning, you're through to Marginalia support. My name is Caio. How can I help?
Hi Caio. I'm calling about order M-1042. It's a copy of Dom Casmurro, by Machado de Assis, and it arrived on the twenty-fourth of September.
Let me pull that up. Yes, I can see it here. One copy of Dom Casmurro, delivered on the twenty-fourth. What seems to be the problem?
The cover is torn, and about ten pages are folded at the corner. I'd like to send it back.
I'm sorry to hear that. You're well within the thirty-day window, so you can return it free of charge. I'll email you a prepaid label.
Great. Will I get the shipping back as well?
Yes. For a damaged book we refund the full thirty-four eighty, shipping included, as soon as the parcel reaches us.
Thank you for calling Marginalia. Have a good day.
